name: Levin
source:
"Stop... I said, "stop." Avert your eyes from me... I wish to take no part in this."

Fear is an aphrodisiac...

A member of the Ludens, a mysterious group of beings that suddenly appear in World's Odyssey. He is the Agent of Fear, and is the only male amongst the Ludens.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]
